comments.author: Cash
comments.body:
interesting, after doing the math at base stats and adding 3 x Special Fore top royal sails 'assuming that ship these will be used for battle' it appears the OG is fastest overall with that extra stud and reduced row power.

It certainly has the edge in open deep water being heavy Horz sail as well.

If you add up base sail stats, plus the V/H and Row power with 4 studs (18V/25V/0T x 4) for a total number of 582 (sails and row combined) vs. 539 at 3 studs for NG.

Now Turn should also be considered here but in a straight line, with the OG having 10 more base armour than the NG.. I would be safe to assume that even off-the line and in the quarter mile; the OG will be faster..

Both are awesome ships IMO

I also did this analysis with the NC LM and it's base stats are even less than the NG to start out with so no need to waste time with that one
